entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope so. I'm trying to make a return but the website is so confusing. I... I'm just a bit lost.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Mark Peterson. The order number should be... VF77812.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the purchase for the VeloFit Road Cycling Shoes. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

Oh, I guess it's a preference? I'm not sure. I put the cleats on, but the shoes just don't feel right. After every ride, I get these awful blisters on my heels. I just... I can't wear these cycling shoes anymore.

I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters, Mark. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. So just to confirm, there's no damage to the shoe itself, like a broken strap or a tear?
No, they look fine. They just hurt my feet. I saw something about a policy online but I couldn't make sense of it. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like a refund.
Of course, I can absolutely check on that for you. One moment while I review your order details. Okay, I see the delivery was made 61 days ago. Let me just verify our return policy.
Alright, I have good news. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 61, you are well within the window to send them back for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. So you can process that for me now?

Yes, I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now that contains a prepaid shipping label and return instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund to the original payment method.
Wow, that was... much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much, Diana.
You are very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
